title: Price Match
seoDescription: Book direct with Golden Bay Holiday Homes and we'll price-match the same stay on major OTAs.
intro: Found the same property for less on Airbnb, Booking.com, or Expedia? Tell us — we'll match the price on a like-for-like direct booking.
conditions: The competing offer must be for the same property, dates, and guest count.
The offer must be publicly available at the time you contact us.
Taxes, cleaning fees, and service fees are included in the comparison on a like-for-like basis.
Price match applies to direct bookings made through Golden Bay Holiday Homes.
